# User configuration

**Role:** reference
**Status:** generated by `femkit schema docs` — do not edit
**Authority:** none of its own; the schema models are the authority for `<config>/config.toml` (config.md § 3)

## UserConfig

`<config>/config.toml` — choices for this machine (config.md § 3).

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `paths` | [Paths](#paths) | see table | where things go |
| `build` | [BuildChoices](#buildchoices) | see table | how builds are made |
| `launch` | [Launch](#launch) | see table | how processes start |
| `activation` | [Activation](#activation) | see table | how a job's shell gets ready |

## Paths

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `projects` | path, optional | — | the projects root: the person's global material library and their projects (see projects.md § 1). When unset: no project is listed, made or named; each says so, naming this key |

## BuildChoices

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cuda_architectures` | list of text, optional | — | GPU architectures the CUDA environments (&lt;name&gt;-cuda) target, e.g. ["80", "90"]. When unset: installing an environment with a build compiled for CUDA is refused, naming this key |
| `jobs` | integer, optional | — | parallel compile jobs. When unset: the CPUs this process may use (its CPU affinity: on a cluster, the allocation's share, never the whole login node) |

## Launch

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mpi` | list of text, optional | — | how a multi-rank process starts, e.g. ["mpirun", "-np", "{ranks}"]; must pass {ranks}. When unset: a multi-rank check or job, and installing an environment with MPI, are refused, naming this key. Placeholders: `{ranks}` |

## Activation

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `preamble` | list of text, optional | — | the shell lines a run script runs on this machine before it enters an environment — a batch job starts a fresh shell, so a `module load` that puts the manager on PATH belongs here; [] states that none are needed (see config.md § 3.1). When unset: `job probe --write` is refused, naming this key |
| `command` | `source activate` \| `conda activate` \| `mamba activate`, optional | — | how a shell on this machine enters an environment after the preamble — by the activate script on PATH, which a cluster's module puts there, or by the manager's shell function, its own hook evaluated first: one of `source activate`, `conda activate`, `mamba activate` (see config.md § 3.1). When unset: `job probe --write` is refused, naming this key |
